doc.title: Jimmy Owens — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Why musicians moved to Europe
summary: Owens says many left because of segregation, and those who stayed often turned to substance abuse.

story.theme_name: Going abroad: American jazz musicians touring and living in Europe
story.community_name: Going abroad: touring Europe and Japan

blocks.x: I guess that was before Slide Hampton moved to Europe.
But that kind of incident, when you would see him in Europe he would list…

Most of the musicians that moved to Europe—that’s why they moved to Europe, because of the segregation in American and how that affected them musically. You know, what they could not do. If the ones who stayed didn’t move to Europe, then they got substance abuse problems to kind of bury all of that stuff.
